code: const vector<vector<FT_Byte>>&  files = parse_data( data, size_ );
note: The raw PoC bytes are parsed as an SFNT font containing CBLC/CBDT embedded PNG bitmap data.
The CBLC strike exposes a fixed bitmap size, so the fuzzer selects the embedded bitmap strike.
The fixed-size glyph load reaches the embedded bitmap loader with FT_LOAD_COLOR and without FT_LOAD_NO_BITMAP.
The CBDT glyph image payload length and PNG bytes are read from the font-controlled bitmap data.
libpng exposes attacker-controlled IHDR dimensions; the PoC uses width 65537 and height 1.
The large PNG width is truncated to FT_UShort before validation, turning 65537 into bitmap width 1.
The bitmap allocation uses the truncated map width and allocates only one BGRA pixel row.
libpng writes the full IHDR-sized row into row pointers backed by the undersized FreeType bitmap buffer.
